task_spec.name: place_on_cell
task_spec.instruction: Place the supply piece on the highlighted cell without moving other pieces.
task_spec.bench_note: Oct 25 12:4x (after the paper was reset): grid re-measured by the calibrated camera (36.3 mm cells, centre 0.1695/-0.0169). Robot pieces = white plastic bottle caps (~33 mm, ~17 mm tall); supply line on the robot's right, located by gemini-4-argon at x 0.127/0.175/0.221, y -0.125. Humans play coins.

physics.notes: Provisional compliance calibration, not an identified hardware twin. Gravity acts through the official link inertias and finite position-servo stiffness; no Cartesian sag offset is injected. kp units Nm/rad, kv Nm*s/rad, armature kg*m^2, frictionloss and torque_limit Nm. See README.md for measured sag and refit protocol.

wrist.limitation: Mount fit has optical-axis uncertainty; wrist distortion was not calibrated.
